items.title: 12.5 Role of NO and NO2 in smog and PAN formation (smog aur PAN banne mein NO aur NO2 ka role) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.5, printed page 277.

blocks.text: NOₓ living organisms (jaandar) par bohat se harmful (nuqsan dene wale) effects (asrat) ka zimmedar hai. Agle do topics is ke do effects batate hain: photochemical smog (12.5.1) aur peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs) ka banna (12.5.2).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: NOₓ khud bhi phephron (lungs) ko nuqsan deta hai, lekin dhoop mein yeh hydrocarbons ke saath mil kar ozone aur PAN jaise aur bhi harmful cheezen banata hai. Yahi smog ki wajah hain.

items: NOₓ jandaron ke liye harmful hai; yeh photochemical smog aur PAN banne ki wajah hai.
